meta.parties: Kumarajeeva v. Susana Fernando Et Al

rules.statement: A Court has no right to ignore or supersede the appointment made by a testator, as that would be substituting for the testator's mind the mind of the Court, which is totally indefensible.
rules.supporting_quote: "I would emphatically say that the Court has no right to ignore or supersede the appointment made by a testator. That would be to substitute for the testator's mind the mind of the Court a course totally indefensible."
